C1269.title: Uber Subdomain Takeover Bypasses SSO Authentication
C1269.summary: Uber's single sign-on system relied on cross-subdomain cookie sharing for authentication. An attacker took over the unregistered Amazon CloudFront subdomain saostatic.uber.com, combined it with a CSRF protection bypass, and stole the shared session cookie. This allowed bypassing SSO at auth.uber.com and gaining control of accounts on arbitrary Uber subdomains.
